seoTitle: Orange Is the New Black Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Orange Is the New Black test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Piper, Alex, Red, Suzanne, Taystee, Nicky, Poussey, Cindy or Frieda — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the newcomer learning the ropes, the kitchen boss, or the one with a comeback for everything? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, rules and surviving the day, and find out which Orange Is the New Black character you are.

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.title: The Newcomer
characters.summary: Smart, determined and a little bit self-involved. You throw yourself into everything, and you're always learning how to play the game.
description: Like Piper, you can be a bit wrapped up in yourself. She's often accused of being self-obsessed.
You've got a lot to learn, fast. Piper is sentenced to 15 months at Litchfield for carrying drug money for her ex, Alex.
You find your feet. Piper works in the electrical shop, sits on the inmates' advisory council, and is released early in season 6.
characters.flaw: You make everything about you, even when it really isn't.
characters.signature: A big plan, a long speech and a lot of feelings about it.
characters.clashReason: they'd make your problem about them

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.title: The Cool One
characters.summary: Cool, sharp and very good at reading people. You know what's going on before anyone else does, and you never let them see you sweat.
description: Like Alex, you can read people. She's perceptive, and often senses what Piper is really feeling.
You've got a past. Alex used to smuggle drugs for an international cartel.
You end up with the one you want. Nicky arranges a surprise wedding for Alex and Piper in the season 6 finale.
characters.flaw: You keep people guessing, even the ones you love.
characters.signature: A knowing look, a dry comment and the upper hand.
characters.clashReason: they'd see right through you, and tell you so

characters.name: Red
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Tough, proud and fiercely protective. You feed the people you love, and you expect respect in return.
description: Like Red, you run the show. She's the prison's head chef, and she's feared and respected by most of the inmates.
You've always got something going on. Red runs a smuggling business out of the kitchen, but she refuses to bring in drugs.
You've got pull. Red has a strong influence over Healy, one of the prison's officers.
characters.flaw: You hold a grudge, and you never forget an insult.
characters.signature: A hot stove, a steely glare and a family you'd do anything for.
characters.clashReason: they'd never forgive you for insulting their cooking

characters.name: Suzanne
characters.title: The Big Heart
characters.summary: Earnest, imaginative and full of feeling. You love with your whole heart, and you see the world in your own unique way.
description: Like Suzanne, you feel everything deeply. She can be intense, but she's generally gentle and friendly.
You've got hidden talents. Suzanne becomes a star kickball player.
You're braver than you think. Suzanne helps stop a knife fight.
characters.flaw: You take things so literally that you sometimes miss the joke.
characters.signature: A heartfelt poem, a wide-eyed stare and a friend for life.
characters.clashReason: they'd take everything you say very, very seriously

characters.name: Taystee
characters.title: The Brains
characters.summary: Smart, funny and ready to fight for what's right. You've got a head for business, and you never stop believing things can get better.
description: Like Taystee, you're smart and well-read. She has a strong memory, and a head for business and maths.
You work your way up. Taystee works in the prison library, and later becomes Caputo's secretary.
You turn pain into purpose. Taystee starts the Poussey Washington Fund, giving loans to women leaving prison.
characters.flaw: You carry everyone's fight on your shoulders.
characters.signature: A good book, a big laugh and a plan to change things.
characters.clashReason: they'd out-argue you, and quote a book while doing it

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.title: The Wisecracker
characters.summary: Witty, blunt and fiercely loyal. You've always got a comeback, and you'd do anything for the people you love.
description: Like Nicky, you've always got a comeback. She's witty, acerbic and loud.
You're loyal to the people who look after you. Nicky is Red's most trusted helper.
You've got a romantic side. Nicky arranges a surprise wedding for Piper and Alex.
characters.flaw: You hide your real feelings behind a joke.
characters.signature: A smart mouth, a loyal streak and a soft heart.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke at your expense, every single time

characters.name: Poussey
characters.title: The Loyal Friend
characters.summary: Kind, funny and loyal to the end. You make everyone laugh, and you'd stand by your best friend no matter what.
description: Like Poussey, you're good-natured and you love a joke. She's always joking around.
You've got a voice. Poussey is a talented singer.
You're loyal to your best friend. Poussey is fiercely devoted to Taystee.
characters.flaw: You give your heart away too easily.
characters.signature: A big grin, a song in your head and a best friend by your side.
characters.clashReason: they'd always take their best friend's side over yours

characters.name: Cindy
characters.title: The Easygoing One
characters.summary: Bubbly, laid-back and always cheerful. You find the fun in everything, and the shortcut too.
description: Like Cindy, you're bubbly and laid-back. She's always cheerful, and she often avoids responsibility.
You know how to work the system. Cindy pretends to be Jewish to get better food, and later converts for real.
You've got something to say. In season 6, Cindy co-hosts a radio show.
characters.flaw: You'll do almost anything to get out of doing something.
characters.signature: A big laugh, a good shortcut and the best seat in the house.
characters.clashReason: they'd leave you to do all the work

characters.name: Frieda
characters.title: The Survivor
characters.summary: Blunt, tough and always prepared. You keep to yourself, and when things go wrong, you're the one who saw it coming.
description: Like Frieda, you're blunt and tough. She's a curmudgeonly survivalist.
You're good at growing things. Frieda looks after the prison greenhouse and garden.
You're always ready for the worst. Frieda builds a secret bunker in an abandoned pool, and hides other inmates there during the riot.
characters.flaw: You trust nobody, and you'd rather be alone than be let down.
characters.signature: Muddy gloves, a secret stash and a plan for the end of the world.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you, bluntly, that you're not ready

questions.text: It's your first day at a new job, and you don't know anyone. You...

options.text: Try way too hard to get everyone to like you
Hang back, and watch how everyone behaves
Pick one person, and decide they're your new best friend
Find the exits, and work out who you can trust

questions.text: You're invited to a potluck. You bring...

options.text: A homemade dish that puts everyone else's to shame
Something from the shop, in a homemade-looking dish
A board game, and you're keeping score
Yourself, and a lot of very good one-liners

questions.text: You've got a whole day to yourself. You spend it...

options.text: Curled up with a good book
Working in the garden
Singing along to your favourite songs, loudly
Planning a new side business

questions.text: Someone takes credit for your idea. You...

options.text: Call it out, with proof
Make sure they understand it won't happen twice
Stew about it, then tell everyone who'll listen
Shrug. Less work for you

questions.text: A friend is going through a hard time. You...

options.text: Make them laugh until they forget about it
Tell them the hard truth, as nicely as you can manage
Cook them something, and make them eat it
Leave them be. They'll come to you when they're ready

questions.text: A friend is about to make a big mistake. You...

options.text: Read the situation, and say exactly what they don't want to hear
Make a sarcastic joke about it, then help clean up the mess
Give them a long speech about what they should do instead
Tell them gently, because you'd want the same

questions.text: Your workplace brings in an unfair new rule. You...

options.text: Start a petition, and get everyone to sign it
Find a way around it, quietly
Complain, then find a way to do even less
Follow it exactly, even when it makes no sense

questions.text: Someone you're dating gives you mixed signals. You...

options.text: Overthink every message, and ask all your friends
Play it cool. You know exactly what's going on
Write them a poem, and read it out loud
Flirt with someone else, just to see what happens

questions.text: You hear a rumour about a friend. You...

options.text: Defend them, no question
Pass it on. It's too good not to
Ask them directly. You'd rather hear it from them
Ignore it. Gossip is how people get hurt

questions.text: A big storm is forecast. You...

options.text: Relax. You've had supplies ready for months
Hope it means work gets cancelled
Take charge, and give everyone a job
Check on your best friend first

questions.text: You're new in prison, and the most powerful inmate expects respect. You...

options.text: Say exactly what you think of her, and regret it instantly
Keep your head down, and choose your allies carefully
Make yourself useful, until she trusts you
Decide, right away, that she's amazing

questions.text: You're in prison, and the inmates take over during a riot. You...

options.text: Write a list of demands, and fight for real change
Disappear to your secret hideout
Grab the best snacks before anyone else does
Get swept up in it, then worry you've done something wrong
